spec.title: Estimated CPU Cost (Next 30 Days)
spec.description: Projected cost for the next 30 days if today's CPU quota stays unchanged. This is a forward-looking estimate based on the current snapshot, not a historical calculation — see Actual CPU Cost (Last 30 Days) for what was actually incurred.

spec.title: Actual CPU Cost (Last 30 Days)
spec.description: Time-weighted actual cost: plots the real CPU hard-quota cost over the last 30 days, so a mid-month change (e.g. 5 vCPU for 15 days then 20 vCPU for 15 days) shows up as a step in the trend instead of being flattened into a single snapshot value.
